sentences.en: They're trying to preserve the status quo, not to improve.
sentences.zh: 他们试图保持现状，而不是改进。

sentences.en: She should fill out her marital status in the questionnaire.
sentences.zh: 她在问卷中应该填写婚姻状况。

sentences.en: The boss wants a status update on the criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 老板想要了解关于这起刑事案件的最新进展。
